title: Wishlist on Steam Bump?
author: JonQGamer
selftext:
Hi everyone, I have been working on a game the last several months and it's about to launch on Steam in a few days. 

I only started marketing when its store page went live on the first of the month, and the only paid marketing I've done so far is boosting a couple of reels on Instagram and very limited (and ineffective) ads using Google ads.

The last few days there's been a big surge and wish list for my game, and I'm wondering if that has to do with a bump that steam gives it heading to release or if my marketing is just working? I really have no idea!

I'm getting the typical pushback for it being "AI Slop", and I'm actually pretty proud that I crossed the 1,000 wish list barrier, as my goal was 200 :)

Any insights from other devs in here would be greatly appreciated!

comments.author: Kanzes
comments.body: Because of steam calendar i guess?

replies.author: JonQGamer
replies.body: I was thinking the same thing, was just really nice to see the game getting 3 to 400 wish lists a day. Hoping the bump helps the release in a few days!
